name: ORLM (Operations Research Language Model)
one_liner: Trains open-weight LLMs on synthetic operations-research formulations whose programs execute in the COPT mixed-integer solver, then solves problems via LLM+Solver.

loop.proposes: An LLM translates complex industrial scheduling, routing, and supply-chain descriptions into formal mathematical models and COPT Python code.
loop.judged_by: The COPT mathematical programming solver executes the generated MIP/LP script and reports the solver optimum.
loop.steers: During synthetic data curation (OR-Instruct) unexecutable programs are discarded; at inference the code is run and the solver optimum is reported.

headline_result: Outperformed GPT-4 across NL4Opt, MAMO, and IndustryOR benchmarks using a 7B open-weight model paired with the COPT solver.
caveat: As in all Formalize-and-Solve systems, solver optimality applies to the generated algebraic model rather than unstated domain nuances.
beyond_harness_note: An exact mathematical programming solver (COPT) both discards unexecutable synthetic training programs and computes the final optimization solution.
algorithmic_authority: COPT mixed-integer and linear programming solver

sources.title: ORLM: A Customizable Framework in Training Large Models for Automated Optimization Modeling (Operations Research / arXiv:2405.17743)

verification.notes: Checked against Tang et al., arXiv:2405.17743.
